description: This PHP file defines the EmployeeImmigrationRecord class, which models an employee's immigration document data (passport or visa) in the OrangeHRM system. It includes attributes like passport number, issuance and expiry dates, comments, and country code, mapped to a database table using Doctrine ORM annotations.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecord
classes.description: Represents an immigration record (passport or visa) linked to an employee, including details like number, dates, and country.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the employee associated with this immigration record.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an employee with this immigration record.

methods.name: getRecordId
methods.description: Returns the record ID.

methods.name: setRecordId
methods.description: Sets the record ID.

methods.name: getNumber
methods.description: Returns the passport or visa number.

methods.name: setNumber
methods.description: Sets the passport or visa number.

methods.name: getIssuedDate
methods.description: Returns the date the passport or visa was issued.

methods.name: setIssuedDate
methods.description: Sets the issued date.

methods.name: getExpiryDate
methods.description: Returns the expiry date of the passport or visa.

methods.name: setExpiryDate
methods.description: Sets the expiry date.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns comments related to the immigration record.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets comments for the immigration record.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the document type (passport or visa).

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the document type.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the I-9 status.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the I-9 status.

methods.name: getReviewDate
methods.description: Returns the review date for I-9 compliance.

methods.name: setReviewDate
methods.description: Sets the review date.

methods.name: getCountryCode
methods.description: Returns the country code associated with the immigration document.

methods.name: setCountryCode
methods.description: Sets the country code.
